source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Being appropriate to offer only once curative or disease-directed treatment has already been fully and formally discontinued for the client","B":"Taking the place of the other ongoing pulmonary care the client would otherwise still need to continue receiving from their team","C":"Address symptom management, goals of care discussions, and support for the client and family, regardless of whether disease-directed treatment continues","D":"Applying mainly during the client's final days of life, rather than earlier in the overall course of their chronic illness"}}
source_row.rationale: Palliative care consultation for a client with severe, advanced COPD can help address symptom management (such as dyspnea), goals of care discussions, and support for the client and family, integrated alongside ongoing disease-directed treatment rather than only when treatment is discontinued or death is imminent.
